remarks: Come take a look at this beautiful 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath unit in the highly sought-after Winnapauk Village Complex. The front of this unit overlooks some of the complex's best amenities, including the clubhouse, pool area, and the clubhouse. Within the clubhouse, you'll find a gym, a racquetball court, and a hall perfect for hosting events. The complex also features tennis courts for your enjoyment.  As you enter, you'll be welcomed by a large living room featuring a cozy fireplace and a patio-perfect for enjoying a morning or evening cup of tea. The first floor also includes a half bath, a coat closet, and a kitchen with some updated appliances. You'll appreciate the beautiful hardwood floors throughout the first floor.  On the second floor, you'll find two spacious bedrooms and a full bath. The convenience of having the washer and dryer on the same level means no more lugging laundry up and down stairs-everything is easily accessible from the bedrooms.  Come out and see this amazing complex for yourself!
